title: Tenma Saki — An Unexpected Phone Call〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There...
I'm done with all my homework...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
I can finally think about Valentine's Day stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We even have Airi helping us out, so I really need to try my best with this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, we'll all be baking chocolate cakes as the base for our gifts since Emu and I don't have much experience with this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I still need to think about what I specifically want to do with my cake!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... It'd be great to make it look like a live house or like we're doing a show somehow♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I should take a look at the sites Airi recommended!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see. The chocolate cakes are...
Oh, they're on this page!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...! These all look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! The chocolate coating on this one's so shiny!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And the chocolate frosting on this one's so cute! Oh, the one next to it has lots of berries on it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I didn't realize you could decorate chocolate cakes in so many different ways.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They all look really cute and delicious too.
I kinda want to try taking ideas from all of them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hang on, that reminds me.
Airi said that cakes don't have to be round. They can be almost any shape you want.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's keep searching.
Hmm... How about over here?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, so many pics of sponge cakes!
They all look so fluffy and yummy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, this one... It's a heart!
How did they make this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, they took a round one, split it and attached it to a square one! That's so cool! It's like a puzzle!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hey, they even have star-shaped rings for pancakes...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (“Leo/need” comes from the name of a constellation, so it'd be awesome if I could make a star.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But this is only for pancakes, so it'd probably be too small.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Aren't there any cakes that are just the right size and look like a star...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Star cakes... Star-shaped cakes...
Oh, hey!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Okay, it says to make a round cake as per normal, cut it into fifths... No, wait, it says sixths...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Take the five-pointed pieces and point them outward to form a star...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ohh! And you use the last piece to fill the gap in the middle!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That's genius! It's like that other puzzle cake, but this one turns into a star!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know you could do so much with just one cake!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is great! I'm gonna use this chance to look up and draw as many cake designs as I can♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wow, the icing on these cookies are so colorful! I didn't know they made them in these colors...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hmm... Cookies, huh? All these different shapes too... It's nice that you can come up with what to make on your own.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, what if I made some amps and speakers? That'd make it feel more like a show, right?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Alright, I should draw that too...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It's done...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The “Leo/need Special Chocolate Stage”!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not bad if I do say so myself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now it's a matter of whether or not I can actually make it. I'll make sure to ask Airi to see what she thinks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I can turn this drawing into a real cake...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You really made this yourself, Saki?
It's incredible. It looks just like a live house stage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It really does. This must've been very challenging to make. Thank you for going through all this trouble just for us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, Saki, good job...
I mean, you always stay late to practice, so a surprise like this means so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It'd be great to perform on stage like this if it actually existed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too! It'd be the best stage for us to perform our best original songs!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means we'd also have to invite Shizuku, Miku and everyone else to show them just how much we've grown, as well as our appreciation for them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We should totally do that♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want Ichi, Hona and Shiho to really like it, and I wanna show Miku and the others just how much we appreciate them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. The “Leo/need Special Chocolate Stage” is gonna be something really special...
